summary: Phase 6 of 8 complete (all three sub-phases 6.1/6.2/6.3). Hand-migrated Cslib/Logics/Modal/Metalogic/InterSystem/IntToClassical.lean's raw-constructor witness-construction sites to build via the Phase-3 SchemaUnion bridges (schemaUnion_kTags_iff_KAxiom, schemaUnion_tTags_iff_TAxiom, schemaUnion_s4Tags_iff_S4Axiom) instead of directly naming <Sys>Axiom.ctor. A full grep enumeration at the start of 6.1 found the real in-scope site count to be 12 (10 KAxiom + 1 TAxiom + 1 S4Axiom raw-constructor witnesses), not the plan's ~36 estimate -- the estimate over-counted arms of the file's four match-h-with blocks, which destructure the permanently out-of-scope intuitionistic inductives (IKModalAxiom/ITModalAxiom/IS4ModalAxiom/IS5ModalAxiom) and require zero migration (their definitions and destructuring stay exactly as-is forever). All 12 real sites were migrated across three clusters (6.1: implyK/implyS/efq/andI; 6.2: andE1/andE2/orI1/orI2; 6.3: orE/modalK plus the two cross-family witness sites TAxiom.modalT and S4Axiom.modalFour), each committed as its own green substep. Every migrated witness closes with a bare rfl since ModalSchemaTag.Holds is byte-identical in shape to the retired constructor's argument; tag-set membership discharges with by decide. The two cross-family sites (embedded in itAxiom_derivable_in_T's .tBox arm and is4Axiom_derivable_in_S4's .fourBox arm) were not tricky: only the leaf witness term changed, the enclosing match on the out-of-scope intuitionistic inductive was left untouched in both cases, and both docstrings were updated for accuracy. Zero sorry, zero new axiom, zero vacuous definitions, no inductive deleted (KAxiom/TAxiom/S4Axiom/ModalAxiom and all five out-of-scope intuitionistic families remain live). Public API unchanged: every migrated theorem keeps its original name and type.
